object_description: elongated school wing and perpendicular gymnasium around a courtyard
design_condition: The elongated wing on the northern edge and the perpendicular gymnasium form a courtyard-like playground, while the western park connects the complex to the district and the eastern playing field requires substantial earthworks.

positive.statement: The precise placement of the new buildings creates a clear situation with two strong outdoor spaces.
The landscape concept creates a natural embedding, a clear address and diverse open spaces with high atmospheric and functional quality.
The moderate height development and striking longitudinal section are appropriate and harmonious for a primary school.
The internal structure of the elongated building is simple and clear.
The first floor forms a memorable learning landscape with three clusters and well-lit classrooms.
The clearly structured areas with their own entrances convey a feeling of home and enable autonomous use.
The construction system should enable efficient and sustainable construction through a clear grid and robust details.

negative.statement: A different solution would have to be found for the grass playing field because of the difficult earthworks and embankment situation.
The arrangement of group rooms in the existing building is unsuitable.
The care-area intersections with the staircases are not ideal.
The large room depths on the ground and basement floors create inadequate lighting conditions.
The determining facade material is viewed critically with regard to the resulting expression.
The stepped section reduces the available space and the efficiency of the photovoltaic system.
The high spatial quality is limited to the well-lit clusters on the top floor, while lower rooms are less flexible and difficult to use in terms of lighting.
